head_commit.message:
fix(ecosystem): stop linking the private actenon-cloud repository

ecosystem.yaml gave actenon-cloud a github.com URL and the licence text
"source-available; see its LICENSE". The repository is private, so the
link 404s for every reader of a public README, and there is no LICENSE
they can see. The same line is rendered into protocol, kernel, permit
and scan READMEs: it is the only failing URL in the protocol, kernel and
permit link checks, and scan passes only because its lychee config
excludes that URL.

- The renderer now treats an optional entry's url as optional and renders
  an entry without one as a plain name.
- actenon-cloud has no url, and its licence text states what a reader can
  verify: a private repository, not publicly available.
- Both copies of ecosystem.yaml and this README's table are updated; the
  stale docstring example is corrected.

Sibling READMEs are checked against the published package's
ecosystem.yaml, so they can only be regenerated (and their lychee
exclusions removed) after a protocol release that contains this change.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01AWNAfEkZsFvwvUGh6dF8bh

head_commit.message:
fix(conformance): runner prints the same compatibility mark as the docs

The runner's verdict (and RUNNER_SPEC.md, generate_vectors.py) said
"Actenon-compatible v1.1.0" while README.md and CONFORMANCE.md, whose
mark verify-claims pins to the package version, promise v1.3.0
(E2E finding F25; the Total 258 double count was fixed in a306820).
The runner now derives the mark from the installed package version, the
docs say v1.3.0, and a test requires every mark in README, CONFORMANCE,
RUNNER_SPEC, the generator and the runner's output to agree.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
